answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Each submission hangs on the yarrow of a task receipt, and the zephyr is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The walnut of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
